# Make A Surgical Change With Confidence

When I need to add or edit an element, I want a CLI that refuses any write that would make the tree invalid, so I never have to hand-edit intent.yaml to get it right.

## Safe Surgical Writes

Minimize the chance that a write leaves the tree in an invalid state.

### Hand-Edited YAML Drifts From Schema

**Kind:** Risk

A hand-edited intent.yaml diverges from the schema or the containment rule because nothing checked it before it was saved.

### Writes Refused When Invalid

**Kind:** Requirement

Every mutating command must re-validate the whole tree before writing, and write nothing at all if validation fails.

**Acceptance criteria:**

- add, set, link, mv, promote, and record all pass through the same validation gate before touching disk.

**Mitigates:**

- [Hand-Edited YAML Drifts From Schema](#hand-edited-yaml-drifts-from-schema)
